answer: Price admission with a surge burn: the admission kernel makes each new key burn PoA before its first reward, and the price doubles for every 50 keys admitted in the same epoch, then resets. An honest newcomer pays a ripple of 10 PoA. A farm pushing 1,000 keys at once faces about 10x2^20 PoA for the last one, so it must queue at the wharf in batches of 50 across 20+ epochs while the established set grows around it. Burned, not staked, so nothing is refunded to recycle.
